item.tib: khrag mtsho khol ma snying 'byin gsod byed nag po chen po'i rgyud zhes bya ba
item.skt: rak+ta mu le ba ha saM tsit+ta ma ra du ma hA kA la tan+t+ra nA ma
item.coloph: khrag mtsho khol ma bsod byed snying 'byin gyi rgyud rdzogs s+ho// /rgya gar gyi mkhan po paN tri ta rdo rje gdan pa dang/ bos kyi lo tsha ba tsa mi sangs rgyas grags pas rgyur bstan la phab pa'o// //rgyud 'di dpal chen po ye shes mgon po'i gsang rgyud du bzhedo// //gzhan 'di ma rgyud du grags pa yin no/
